import json,subprocess,sys
MAIN='submission/main.py'
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,(json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode==0 else None)
def msg(start,headers,body=b''):
    return (('\r\n'.join([start]+headers)+'\r\n\r\n').encode('latin-1')+body).hex()
cfg={"accounts":[{"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}],"peers":[{"id":"e","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1000,"capacity":10}
def one(name,fromv,extra=None):
    hs=[f'From: {fromv}', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>','Call-ID: c','CSeq: 1 MESSAGE','Content-Length: 0']
    if extra: hs+=extra
    w=msg('MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0',hs)
    rc,j=run({"version":1,"config":cfg,"events":[{"t":0,"peer":"e","auth":"alice","egress":"internal","wire_hex":w}]})
    print(name,rc,j['results'][0]['decision'],j['results'][0].get('reason'),j['results'][0].get('tag'))
